acceptance: `todo-db --version` on PATH reports 0.11.0 or later, and a new session started in this repository gets a "Bound store" section from `get_instructions`.
The global `todo` skill copies teach `expect_store`: the global pin is at or after skill-sync-skills `c624975` and has been applied.
The release procedure lists the local rollout after a tag (reinstall the global tool, bump and apply the global skill pin), so the next release does not leave either behind.
context: Found 2026-10-31. The README documents `uv tool install "./todo_db-$VERSION-py3-none-any.whl[mcp]"`; installing the v0.11.0 release wheel that way gives a pinned, checksum-verified runtime. Restart running sessions afterwards: a server keeps its version until it restarts.
description:
0.11.0 fixed silent binding to the wrong tracker: the "Bound store" section and `get_instructions(expect_store=...)`. The maintainer's machine still runs the old runtime and the old skill text, so the fix is inactive outside BenchBox.

- Runtime: `todo-db --version` on PATH reports 0.10.1. The uv tool receipt (`~/.local/share/uv/tools/todo-db/uv-receipt.toml`) installed it from `directory = /Users/joe/Developer/todo-db`, which copies the tree at install time, so merges and tags never update it. Clients that launch `todo-db-mcp` from PATH get 0.10.1: this repository's `.mcp.json` (no arguments) and `~/.gemini/settings.json`. Codex runs `uv run --project ~/Developer/todo-db --locked -- todo-db-mcp` and follows the primary clone instead. On 2026-10-31 a server started from this repository answered `get_instructions(expect_store="joeharris76/todo-db")` with no "Bound store" section, which is the 0.10.1 behaviour: `expect_store` is ignored.
- Skill: the global copies (`~/.claude/skills/todo`, `~/.agents/skills/todo`, `~/.codex/skills/todo`) never mention `expect_store`. The global pin `deployment/global/skill-sync.conf` in skill-sync-skills still pins the catalog at `48be048`, before skill-sync-skills#99 (`c624975`). The primary catalog clone has uncommitted owner edits to that file and to README.md, so an agent cannot bump it safely.
- Process: `docs/operations/release-gates.md` covers the gates before the tag but no rollout step after it.
